python.note: PyO3 para extensiones, wasmtime-py para execution

pyo3_binding.python_usage:
from module import DataProcessor
p = DataProcessor()
p.add(1.0)
print(p.mean())

wasmtime_execution.code:
from wasmtime import Instance, Module, Store

store = Store()
module = Module.from_file(store.engine, 'module.wasm')
instance = Instance(store, module, [])

result = instance.exports(store).add(5, 3)
print(f'Result: {result}')
